title: Escape from the Injection

coreLoop: tap the left or right half of the screen to move one lane across three lanes
avoid falling syringes; each collision reduces the chaser gap by 45 points
collect courage stars for 25 points and restore 12 points of chaser distance
clean running gradually rebuilds the gap up to 250 points
every 40 seconds advance to a new route and increase obstacle speed up to the configured cap
when the gap reaches 55 points the chaser catches the blob and the run ends after the short catch animation
restart from the result card and try to beat the previous escape distance
fairness: lane changes are deterministic and respond to one tap without requiring a precision drag
syringe patterns preserve a viable lane and never intentionally create a simultaneous three-lane wall
the chaser gap is the single health resource and its changes are visible and understandable
courage stars are optional risk/reward and must not be required to survive
speed progression is capped and must preserve a readable reaction window
the caught sequence is brief, non-graphic and the result state is clear

reviewFocus: Prioritize non-graphic, child-appropriate presentation; keep the syringe hazard readable without frightening imagery.
Check that three lanes and drag-to-dodge controls are obvious and reliable.
Evaluate whether obstacles, stars, and the chaser create meaningful risk/reward rather than unavoidable hits.
Inspect changing locations, speed escalation, feedback, and replay affordance.
